react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-enrichment paradigms converge on steroid hormone biosynthesis and metabolism as the dominant biological signal in this dataset. RaMP multi-DB ORA (FDR=6.44×10⁻¹⁵) and MetaboAnalystR KEGG-specific PSEA (p=8.39×10⁻⁶) both rank KEGG:hsa00140 / KEGG:map00150 'Androgen and Estrogen Metabolism' as the unequivocal top hit, with five input steroids (DHEA, androstenedione, testosterone, estradiol, estrone) present as pathway members. Mummichog's m/z-direct analysis independently confirms the same axis with 100% overlap (11/11 compounds in the module, p=8.40×10⁻⁵), demonstrating that this is not a namespace artefact but a reproducible mass-feature signal. The driver metabolites span the C19 androgen and C18 estrogen series, connected by the canonical 3β-HSD (DHEA ↔ androstenedione), aromatase CYP19A1 (androstenedione → estrone → estradiol via 17β-HSD), and 17β-HSD1 reactions. Menadione (vitamin K₃) and (S)-3-hydroxyisobutyric acid appear as peripheral hits in tryptophan/propanoate branches, consistent with secondary metabolic co-variation rather than independent pathway disruption. Indoleacetaldehyde (tryptophan → indole-3-acetaldehyde) shows nominal enrichment via the kynurenine arm, but does not reach the significance threshold of the steroid core. The cross-paradigm consensus — ORA hits in two independent DBs, m/z-direct confirmation, fold-enrichments >10³ — strongly implicates altered steroidogenesis or steroid catabolism as the primary biological response.

react_result.final_narrative_text: Over-representation analysis against KEGG (MetaboAnalystR) ranks KEGG:hsa00140 as the top hit with p = 8.391 × 10⁻⁶. RaMP multi-database ORA independently ranks KEGG:map00150 (Androgen and Estrogen Metabolism) at rank 3 with FDR = 6.44 × 10⁻¹⁵, sharing the same five steroid compounds (DHEA, androstenedione, testosterone, estrone, estradiol) with the KEGG hit. Mummichog network-based activity profiling confirms the same five compounds as the overlap set for MUMM:androgen_and_estrogen_biosynthesis_and_metabolism at p = 2.52 × 10⁻⁴. All three paradigms converge on the same five steroid metabolites. Indoleacetaldehyde achieves nominal enrichment in tryptophan metabolism (mummichog p = 0.037). The five steroid compounds (DHEA, androstenedione, testosterone, estrone, estradiol) are the drivers of this enrichment.
